{{Quote|With success has come detractors. Both the Biological Athletes Union and the Committee Against Non-Sentient Abuse have been protesting matches. These social objections have failed to gain traction with the public, however.|HoloNet News report|<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|sports/1344_1.html|Nuna-Ball League Looks to Expand}}</ref>}}
The '''Biological Athletes Union''' was an organization active<ref name="HNN" /> by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="22 BBY" /> After the growth in popularity experienced by the [[Nuna-Ball League]]'s matches of [[Nuna-ball/Legends|nuna-ball]], a sport that involved teams of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] using a [[Nuna/Legends|nuna]] creature as a ball and therefore required little [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] involvement other than that of repair [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], the Biological Athletes Union, along with the [[Committee Against Non-Sentient Abuse]], protested against the matches. Their objections, however, did not gain traction with the public, which was noted on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 13:4:4 in an issue of the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Biological Athletes Union was first mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 50|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #50'']], an [[in-universe]] issue of the HoloNet News<ref name="HNN" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]] on [[April 4]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN50 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6308795|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=Mavrick889|date=2002-04-04|time=3:16 PM|archivedate=20200305125429}}</ref>
